test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 5 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the following blanks, will complete the letter-series.

C _ _ N M _ V B N _ C V _ _ M C _ B N _
solution:
Here, the pattern follows is __**CVBNM**__

Let's check the options:

 
• C **__V__ __B__** N M - __**C**__ V B N __**N**__ - C V __**C**__ __**M**__ M - C __**V**__ B N __**M**__ → Doesn't follow the pattern.
 
• C __**V**__ __**B**__ N M - __**C**__ V B N __**M**__ - C V __**B**__ __**N**__ M - C __**V**__ B N __**M**__ → The pattern follows here is __**CVBNM**__.
 
• C __**V**__ __**B**__ N M - __**C**__ V B N __**N**__ - C V __**B**__ __**N**__ M - C __**V**__ B N __**M**__ → Doesn't follow the pattern.
 
• C __**V**__ __**B**__ N M - __**C**__ V B N __**N**__ - C V __**C**__ __**N**__ M - C __**V**__ B N __**B**__ → Doesn't follow the pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is __**VBCMBNVM**__.
